chronicle.signals module

Signal handlers for article approval side effects.

When an article is approved for the first time, subscribers are emailed and the article is logged to the internal approved-articles endpoint.

chronicle.signals.cache_old_approved(sender, instance, **kwargs)[source]

Cache the previous approved value on the instance before saving.

Parameters:

  • sender – The model class (Article).

  • instance (Article) – The article about to be saved.

chronicle.signals.on_article_approved(sender, instance, created, **kwargs)[source]

Fire side effects when an article flips from unapproved to approved.

Parameters:

  • instance (Article) – The article that was just saved.

  • created (bool) – True if the article was newly created.

chronicle.signals.post_to_approved_api(article)[source]

POST the approved article to the internal approved-articles endpoint.

Parameters:

article (Article) – The approved article.

chronicle.signals.send_email_to_subscribers(article)[source]

Email every reader subscribed to the author or publisher of the article.

Parameters:

article (Article) – The approved article.
